default_board_qa.question: What is the primary data source?
How can this figure be audited?
default_board_qa.answer: Deterministic SQL evaluation against snapshot hash {snapshot_hash} reproduces the figure within ±0.1%.

standard_limitations.single_sheet: Single dataset evaluated on verified empirical records without external benchmarking data.
standard_limitations.partial_year: Observation period covers fewer than 330 days; full-year extrapolation should be avoided.
standard_limitations.correlation_boundary: Data demonstrates observed distribution and correlation; underlying causal mechanisms require longitudinal testing.
